rationale: Revision 1fe1bfe6a4e39975a5a4150a7e58aa14e37ceb6f has a sound mechanism (dependency identity with worktree-path normalization and contained links, probe-mutation guard, tracked-file failures, non-reclaiming locks, retry on join timeout) with passing check:fast and e2e; codex's remaining point is real but confined to the shipped example's declared paths — top-level node_modules/.bin shims and package links are generated from inputs already keyed (lockfile and package.json in the tree, pnpm version probe), whereas declaring all of node_modules would never reuse because .modules.yaml/.pnpm-workspace-state-v1.json carry install timestamps and vitest writes node_modules/.vite — so it belongs in a follow-up that adds those shims/links to the example (or leaves the example uncached) rather than blocking this revision.
